head: claude/velotrade-exec-creds
title: fix(prop): executor tick exports the account login keys (velotrade_1 REST tick exited 4 no_credentials) [HELD, Tier 2]
body:
**The bug, observed on the VM:** both `ict-prop-executor@velotrade_1` ticks so far (08:48Z and 08:53Z on 2026-10-06, diag #16735) ended `{"feasibility": "no_credentials"}`, exit 4, which also fires OnFailure. The REST tick added in #16705 logs in fresh every run, but `scripts/ops/prop_executor_tick.sh` only exported the kill switch and `DASHBOARD_API_TOKEN`. The browser ticks never needed the login, because they reuse the feed's saved session.

**The fix:** for every non-`breakout_1` account, the wrapper now also exports the account's own login keys from `scripts/prop/prop_env_keys.py`. These are the same two keys `prop_feed_tick.sh` exports (for velotrade_1, `VELOTRADE_DX_USERNAME` / `VELOTRADE_DX_PASSWORD`). Values are never echoed. Browser accounts (tradeify_1) still reuse the session and ignore the keys.

**Meanwhile:** the velotrade_1 executor timer is paused (`executor-disable-timer`) to stop the 5-minute OnFailure alerts. The feed keeps running. Re-enable it with `executor-enable-timer` after this merges and deploys.

**Tests:** a new wrapper regression test; `test_prop_executor_tick`, the dxtrade adapter, dxtrade_api and velotrade wiring suites all pass (190 passed); `bash -n` clean.

**Revert:** revert this PR.
